text:
Power exceeds 5 mW only at high-supply corners, where it reaches 5.43 mW. The −3 dB bandwidth has about 4.7× margin (2.8 GHz against 590 MHz), so cutting I1 to about 0.85 mA should bring worst-case power to about 4.2 mW. Lower current also means lower overdrive, which should ease the marginal swing failure at sf/1.62 V. The topology stays the same, so a numerical refine is enough.
